violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Sanitize Each Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(b))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Sanitize Each Crib
violation_type.typical_finding: Caregivers do not sanitize cribs routinely prior to another infant using it.

finding_variants.text: Caregivers do not sanitize cribs routinely prior to another infant using it.
One crib had lots of debrie and stains on  the crib sheet. The  plexiglass was smeared. The other crib had  paper rolls, and a balled up crib sheet. Pictures were taken of these findings.

Observed a toddler taken out of a crib and another infant laid down in the same crib with the same crib sheet. This was corrected when it was discussed with the caregivers that the crib must be sanitized and the sheet changed prior to use by another child.

This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient.  Two infant cribs had soiled crib sheets that had not been changed at least six days after children were absent or no longer in care at the operation.
In the older infant room, sheets in two cribs had food particulate on them despite none of the children in care having used the cribs today.
